out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels at the handsink near the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed food in the handsink in the prep area, suggesting it is being used as a dump sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Discontinue using the handsink in this area for anything except hand washing. The EHS educated the PIC on this requirement.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: several dozen eggs were being stored at room temperature and were 60ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. The PIC explained that they are using time as a public health control. The eggs were out for 1 hour. The PIC will use them within 3 hours. Ensure that any TCS foods left out at room temperature for more than 4 hours are discarded, in keeping with the requirements of TPHC. The PIC and EHS created a TPHC procedure for these foods during the inspection, which was entered into the record.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked rice noodles were 70º and 77º and being held at room temperature. Raw bean sprouts were 67º and being held at room temperature. Tofu was 65º before prepping.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC explained that they are using time as a public health control. The foods were out for 2 hours. The PIC will use them within 2 hours. Ensure that any TCS foods left out at room temperature for more than 4 hours are discarded, in keeping with the requirements of TPHC. The PIC and EHS created a TPHC procedure for these foods during the inspection, which was entered into the record.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: large tulle 2-gallon stainless steel cylinders of cooked panang curry were being cooled at room temperature and then cooled in the freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. The EHS educated the PIC on how to properly cool cooked foods. KIIN IMM THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 07/10/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: DOK Clean and Sanitize
violations.observation: The certified food manager was not familiar with how to properly set up to three compartment sink to effectively wash, rinse and sanitize equipment.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge shall know that all utensils and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be 1) washed with hot, soapy water to remove visible soil, 2) rinsed to remove residue, 3) sanitized using an approved sanitizer to reduce the number of bacteria and viruses and 4) air dried. All utensils and equipment must be washed and sanitized after use. The EHS discussed this with the certified food manager. Have the three compartment sink set up properly at the follow up.

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2025 health department permit was posted. The 2026 permit needs to be posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Post the 2026 health department permit by the follow up.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The manager was not familiar with an employee health policy and did not have any documentation for one in place
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the manager with the health department model employee health policy guidance. Train all employees on its contents and have all employees read and sign the forms by the follow up.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: All handwashing sinks must have a sign that says employees must wash hands. There was no such sign at the hand sink between the two prep tables.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Correct by the follow up.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Observed raw beef stored over raw squid in the refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). Do not store raw meats over raw fish and seafood.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed raw beef being stored over cooked dumplings in the reach-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Do not store raw food products, over cooked food products in refrigerators. KIIN IMM THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/12/2026) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: whole shell eggs at the prep and cooking station were being held at room temperature and were 72°F. There were approximately 14 dozen eggs that were out of temperature. There was also three cases of eggs stored on the floor in the kitchen at ambient temperature and not in refrigeration as required.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. Eggs must be stored at 45°F. Discontinue storing eggs at room temperature or use time as a public health control instead. The EHS informed the manager that all the out of temperature eggs needed to be discarded.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: several foods in the main two door prep refrigerator were not being held cold enough. Tofu was 44°, squid was 84°, bean sprouts were 61°. Garlic in oil on the cook line was 83°. Green curry sauce was 45º in the True 2-door unit. Raw bean sprouts were 50º in the Supra 3-door unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The squid was cooled down with ice and in the freezer. The tofu, bean sprouts and garlic and oil mixture was discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Identifying Information
violations.observation: Observed that containers of poisonous and toxic materials or personal care items do not have legible manufacturer's labels. There was a bottle at the ware washing sink that looked to be a bleach bottle with, but it had no label on it.
violations.corrective_action: All containers of poisonous and toxic materials or personal care items shall bear a legible manufacturer's label to prevent accidental contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Label the bleach bottle by the follow up or dispose of it.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed frozen raw meat and chicken being thawed at room temperature in the area between the kitchen and the hallway
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Discontinued thawing frozen foods at room temperature.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: Observed there was no thermometer in the True two-door refrigerator with vegetables in it and the True two-door unit with sticky rice in it.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Ensure all refrigerators have thermometers in them by the follow up.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: containers of ingredients and squeeze bottles of dressings and other sauces were not labeled in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Label all the containers listed above by the follow up.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed three cases of raw shelled eggs stored on the floor in the kitchen. Observed a large bag of carrots stored on the floor in the space between the kitchen and the hallway. Observed large containers of food, stored on the floor in the area between the kitchen and the hallway.
violations.corrective_action: All foods must be stored at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving (not milk crates). Discontinue storing foods on the floor. Correct by the follow- up.

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: a case of tofu was stored in the mop sink during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. Do not store food in the mop sink. Correct by the follow up.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Upon arrival, several food employees were not wearing hair restraints in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Employees put on hair restraints during the inspection. Food employees should wear hair restraints at all times, not just when the EHS shows up for an inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Store all wiping cloths in a sanitizing solution by the follow up.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the spoon for dispensing white rice was stored in standing water that was 70°F. Plastic bowls are being used to dispense rice and sugar from large containers. In use knives were being stored in the gaps between adjacent equipment.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Remove the plastic bowls from the large containers of food and use suitable utensils with a handle and keep the handles out of the food by the follow up. Do not store knives between equipment. Do not store in use utensils in standing water.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: The plastic and cardboard take out containers were all stored with food contact surfaces exposed. All equipment must be stored, inverted or covered to protect from contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. Cover or invert all the plastic and cardboard takeout containers next to the refrigerator by the follow up.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): no crates were being used as shelving in the kitchen. Milk crates are not approved for shelving. Milk crates are not approved for anything in the kitchen except for storing milk from the distributor. Observed manufacturer containers (garlic containers, spice containers, etc.), being reused to store other food in. Observed bare and unpainted plywood shelving used underneath the microwave in the kitchen and in between the two prep tables next to it.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. Remove the milk crates for shelving by the follow up. Reusing manufacturer containers to store other food is not approved. Replace manufacturer containers with NSF or equivalent approved containers. Bare plywood is not an approved surface in a kitchen. It is not non absorbent or easily cleanable. Remove the bare plywood shelving or paint it to make it non-absorbent and easily cleanable correct by the follow up. KIIN IMM THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/12/2026) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: all of the refrigerator door handles were in need of cleaning, especially the areas where food employees touch the handles with their fingers to open them
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean all the refrigerator door handles by the follow up.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the inside of the hood system had some grease buildup on it and was in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the hood system to remove the excess grease by the follow up.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information .
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Provided copies of the EHP ,manager is in process of reviewing the handout with her staff and obtaining signatures. A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703- 246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical ware washing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. The low temperature ware washing machine is not sanitizing properly.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. Do not operate this machine until it is able to properly sanitize utensils and equipment as we discussed during the inspection. Send the service report invoice to me for verification after the repairs have been completed.
